slots.company_description: Allurion Technologies is a medical device and digital health company focused on weight loss treatment. The Allurion Program combines a procedureless intragastric balloon (swallowable capsule), digital therapeutic platform, and behavior change program.
slots.solution_summary: A swallowable intragastric balloon administered without surgery, endoscopy, or anesthesia, paired with a digital care platform and HCP support program for weight loss.
slots.target_customer: Healthcare providers (HCPs) and patients seeking non-surgical weight loss — B2B2C distribution model via healthcare practitioners
slots.transaction_structure: SPAC merger — Allurion merged with Compute Health Acquisition Corp (CPUH) and went public on NYSE in August 2023. Net SPAC cash proceeds: $98.8M.
